parties.respondent: Future Gaming Solutions Pvt. Ltd. & Another Etc.

summary: Service tax on lottery activities; validity of amendments to Finance Act, 1994; Explanation to Section 65(19)(ii) held prospective; deletion of Explanation and insertion of clause (zzzzn) under Section 65(105); actionable claims not goods; service tax not leviable on sale of lottery tickets; batch of appeals including SLPs arising from Sikkim High Court orders; legal characterisation of lotteries; precedence of K. Arumugam ruling; amendments challenged; constitutional challenges; scope of service tax on games of chance.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Entry 62, List I
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned orders of Sikkim High Court set aside; service tax on lottery sale not sustained in light of K. Arumugam; amendments held not retrospective; levy on actionable claims invalid.
